tools.name: search-posts
tools.title: Search X Posts
tools.description: Searches one page of public X posts from the last seven days and returns a continuation token for explicitly requested additional results

tools.name: search-my-posts
tools.title: Search My X Posts
tools.description: Searches the authenticated user's retrievable post and reply history by paginating through up to X's 3,200 most recent authored posts

tools.name: search-my-connections
tools.title: Search My X Connections
tools.description: Searches the authenticated user's following by name, username, or profile details, falling back to followers only when following has no matches

tools.name: get-timeline
tools.title: Get X Timeline
tools.description: Gets one page of posts from the authenticated user's X home timeline without automatically fetching more billed pages

tools.name: post
tools.title: Post to X
tools.description: Publishes a confirmed X post with optional media, quote, poll, and reply settings

tools.name: post-thread
tools.title: Post X Thread
tools.description: Publishes a confirmed ordered thread by chaining each post as a reply to the previous post

tools.name: get-user
tools.title: Get X User
tools.description: Gets an X user profile and optionally one explicitly requested page of their recent posts

tools.name: get-user-connections
tools.title: Get X User Connections
tools.description: Lists one page of followers or following for any specified accessible X account, not just the authenticated user

tools.name: check-follow-relationship
tools.title: Check X Follow Relationship
tools.description: Verifies whether one specified X account follows another by scanning up to 10,000 following entries; incomplete or failed lookups remain unverified

tools.name: get-bookmarks
tools.title: Get X Bookmarks
tools.description: Gets one explicitly requested page of posts bookmarked by the authenticated X user

tools.name: get-bookmark-folders
tools.title: Get X Bookmark Folders
tools.description: Lists bookmark folders or gets one page of posts from a specific folder

tools.name: get-my-posts
tools.title: Get My X Posts
tools.description: Gets one page of the authenticated user's posts and private analytics from the last 30 days

tools.name: get-mentions
tools.title: Get X Mentions
tools.description: Gets one page of posts that mention the authenticated X user

tools.name: get-post-engagement
tools.title: Get X Post Engagement
tools.description: Gets one page of users who liked or reposted a post, or posts that quote it

tools.name: reply-to-post
tools.title: Reply to X Post
tools.description: Publishes an exact public reply to a specific X post after showing the text for confirmation

tools.name: delete-post
tools.title: Delete X Post
tools.description: Permanently deletes a post owned by the authenticated X user after destructive confirmation

tools.name: set-like
tools.title: Like or Unlike X Post
tools.description: Likes or unlikes a specific X post after confirming the requested public interaction

tools.name: set-repost
tools.title: Repost or Undo X Repost
tools.description: Reposts or removes the authenticated user's repost of a specific X post after confirmation

tools.name: set-bookmark
tools.title: Add or Remove X Bookmark
tools.description: Adds or removes a private bookmark after confirmation

tools.name: set-reply-hidden
tools.title: Hide or Unhide X Reply
tools.description: Hides or unhides a reply in the authenticated user's conversation after confirmation

tools.name: send-dm
tools.title: Send X Direct Message
tools.description: Sends a confirmed 1:1 or group direct message and never performs unsolicited outreach

preferences.name: listwithdetail
preferences.label: Show the Details Pane by Default
preferences.title: List Behavior
preferences.description: Start post lists with the details pane visible; you can toggle it from the action panel

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
